Just Eats With Chef JJ - Light and Easy Entertaining

Radio Host and coffee connoisseur Angela Yee stops by for cocktails and conversations. JJ makes an espresso martini, along with pan-seared chicken with pollo guisado ragout and serves it with a mixed green salad topped with sherry dressing.

Chef JJ is giving his recipes a little kick with some spices that are good for any dish. On the menu is a rigatoni with spicy sausage and spicy apricot ginger wings that are perfect for any occasion.
New Soul Kitchen - A Taste of Greece

Jernard shares his favorite foods from Greece; he makes a beef and lamb gyro with tzatziki sauce, then it's fried calamari with a touch of spice, followed by a traditional Greek salad with feta cheese and honey balsamic dressing.
New Soul Kitchen - Perfect Night for Two

The Chef shows how dinner for two can be made right at home; he makes a Jamaican spiced rasta pasta with shrimp and scallops, then a wedge salad topped with candied bacon and garlic croutons; followed by a coconut mojito with toasted coconut.
Culture Kitchen - Special Dinners for Two

Whether it's an anniversary, or birthday, Chef Bren is showing us some special dinners that will work for every occasion. On the menu is cheesy lobster mac and cheese and then a tarragon mustard short ribs with potatoes and veggies.
Culture Kitchen - Cuban Inspired Family meals

Bren hangs out with her mom And niece Sophia. They lay out great Cuban family meals. On the menu is Carne con papa, which is a slow-cooked beef stew with potatoes. Then they make Picadillo stuffed peppers with olives and raisins.
Living by Design - Janelly And Steffan

In this episode, Jake taps into the family's love of nature and builds a live edge coffee table, and Jazz accents the room in warm cozy earth tone colors. The reveal meal is ramen with fish cakes, and a delicious triple chocolate cake.
Living by Design - Guylene

Jake and Jazz turn a basement into a family hangout space. Jake adds texture to the walls, and Jazz adds pops of color for that wow factor! On the menu are salmon burgers with sweet potato fries, and carrot cupcakes.
